words.example: We put the purchase on hold.

words.example: The status update should say what changed since last Friday.

words.exampleZh: 月报把这个月的投诉和上个月做了对比。

words.example: The certificate authority expired, so browsers warn on every clinical site.
words.exampleZh: 证书颁发机构过期了，每个临床网站上浏览器都在报警。

words.meaning: 证书吊销列表（Certificate Revocation List）
words.example: CRL (Certificate Revocation List) is stale, so revoked badges still authenticate.
words.exampleZh: CRL（证书吊销列表）过期了，已吊销的工卡还能通过认证。

words.meaning: 在线证书状态（Online Certificate Status Protocol）
words.example: OCSP (Online Certificate Status Protocol) timed out, so the portal treated every certificate as unknown.
words.exampleZh: OCSP（在线证书状态）超时了，门户把每张证书都当成未知。
